review_method: All six current design/S01-S06/concept.png files were opened and inspected individually at original resolution. Frozen brief, deck spec, source notes, reference study, style contract, prompts, per-page generation records, retained originals, and generation log were reviewed; the APW showcase concept check was run against the current project root.

review_notes.story_and_data: The six-week checkpoint has a target of three complete rain records, with two complete and one missing record currently represented. The missing record is excluded from the complete sample count. The proposed analysis/report schedule shifts from week 12 to week 14 because complete rain records are insufficient; the change is explicitly unapproved. The sequence from progress comparison through prepared-stage examples, record-quality handling, schedule rationale, and next actions agrees with the brief and source notes.
review_notes.fictional_labels: S01 marks this as a process-scenario example; S02 labels the counts as example/non-measured; S03 labels the stage artifacts as examples; S04 labels the record as example/non-measured and states there are no measured readings or effect conclusions; S05 marks the adjustment as an example and not approved; S06 marks the future actions as examples and the support request as pending. No real measurements, treatment effects, institutional approval, or completed formal review are claimed.
review_notes.visual_review: The six pages use varied compositions while retaining a coherent natural, paper-based visual language. Main titles, counts, missing-data qualifiers, comparison labels, schedule change, and approval boundaries were legible at original size. No material clipping or unsupported result chart was observed.

The record and prompt file hashes agree with the generation log. The four current frozen-input hashes match the pre-generation snapshot and all six page records.

S01 and the final S06 edit record the prior concept as the edit target; S02-S05 record the actual reference-image paths used. The records do not claim that image_gen read the frozen JSON inputs.
